cases.procedure: Exercised clarification ordering guards, behavior fixture FG-BEH-002, and inspected the clarification task.
cases.observation: Clarification remained adaptive, consequential, repository-aware, and read-only; premature advancement was rejected.

cases.procedure: Hashed the bound source and exercised stale revision rejection plus generic route discovery.
cases.observation: Exact source and revisions were retained; stale inputs failed without mutation and routing stayed path and domain independent.

cases.procedure: Ran dynamic catalog discovery, invalid-entry filtering, route candidates, and none/full/custom routes.
cases.observation: QA appeared first, valid direct gates followed lexically, actions were not exposed as gates, and one route decision was accepted.

cases.procedure: Exercised none, full, and custom routing, omission authorization, malformed selections, and a second route attempt.
cases.observation: Accepted route semantics and ROUTE skips were exact; malformed and repeated decisions failed without mutation.

cases.procedure: Exercised none, QA-selected, QA-omitting, and full transition paths plus readiness and QA Review outcomes.
cases.observation: Selected QA stages and readiness ordering matched the requirement and pre-development outcomes did not consume waves.

cases.procedure: Ran deferred readiness tests for both changed and unchanged development snapshots.
cases.observation: Late first-gate addition activated readiness, blocked gate preparation and Seal until PASS, and preserved each immutable snapshot.

cases.procedure: Ran the direct transition matrix across confirmation, routing, readiness, QA, selection, snapshots, waves, Carry, and repair verification.
cases.observation: Every premature operation failed without mutation and succeeded after its direct prerequisite was satisfied.

cases.procedure: Exercised development-worker preparation around every prerequisite and inspected role contracts.
cases.observation: Development preparation stayed blocked until prerequisites passed and only the separate worker task authorized delivery edits.

cases.procedure: Recorded semantic QA and gate outcomes, repeated prepare and record attempts, then retried PENDING and RUNTIME_ERROR.
cases.observation: Semantic results remained authoritative per snapshot and only retryable states could be replaced without duplication.

cases.procedure: Exercised development and repair recomposition, stale-lock Resume, and PENDING review recomposition.
cases.observation: Tasks recomposed without moving boundaries or duplicating transitions, results, or wave counts.

cases.procedure: Exercised late gate addition after a counted wave, late runtime error, frozen transitions, QA addition, duplicate addition, rerouting, and post-Seal attempts.
cases.observation: Only the named late gate became required on the same snapshot; prior results and wave count stayed unchanged and prohibited additions failed.

cases.procedure: Changed bound requirement text, invoked Resume, and recorded a meaning-preserved classification with a live Git identity.
cases.observation: Resume paused without mutation and preserved classification retained route and dependent results while rebinding revision and snapshot.

cases.procedure: Exercised meaning-changed invalidation and inspected bounded and unbounded QA redesign tasks.
cases.observation: Dependent work reset, the single route persisted, prior cases became unapproved input, and fresh design plus review was required.

cases.procedure: Attempted QA Review before design, then composed it after a complete case set and inspected the task.
cases.observation: Early preparation failed; the valid task contained only the exact requirement and cases with the required review dimensions.

cases.procedure: Exercised QA Review PASS, finding-backed FAIL, RUNTIME_ERROR, PENDING recomposition, rework, and malformed results.
cases.observation: PASS unlocked development, FAIL reopened complete-set design, retryable failures stayed in review, and malformed results did not mutate state.

cases.procedure: Exercised severity validation, valid and malformed gate result combinations, and QA failure aggregation.
cases.observation: Each gate finding required one impact severity, status combinations were enforced, and QA failure remained blocking and severity-free.

cases.procedure: Composed discovered-gate prompts and exercised behavior fixture FG-BEH-009.
cases.observation: The task required complete safe checks and related-chain scanning while omitting downstream policy and remaining-wave information.

cases.procedure: Completed blocking and P2-only result paths and inspected the repair task.
cases.observation: Blocking repair input included QA failures and all P0, P1, and P2 findings; P2-only PASS stayed visible and non-blocking.

cases.procedure: Progressively recorded missing, PENDING, RUNTIME_ERROR, PASS, P2-only, QA FAIL, and P0/P1 result sets.
cases.observation: Incomplete or runtime sets did not count and every complete semantic set counted once regardless of outcome.

cases.procedure: Recorded QA and multiple gates then repeated aggregation, Resume, and Seal checks.
cases.observation: The snapshot received one shared increment and repeated processing did not recount it.

cases.procedure: Drove three blocking waves, tested early skip rejection, authorized one extra repair, and exercised P2 repair routing.
cases.observation: The automatic limit was three, one authorization added exactly one cycle, and further repair required further authorization.

cases.procedure: Exercised a mixed repair wave, snapshot advance, Carry composition and recording, and QA reset.
cases.observation: QA always reran and Carry included only previously passing selected gates against the immediate repair comparison.

cases.procedure: Attempted Seal with PENDING and RUNTIME_ERROR, retried runtime work, and authorized a named runtime skip.
cases.observation: PENDING always blocked and runtime error remained visible and uncounted until retry or matching snapshot authorization.

cases.procedure: Exercised pre-limit blocker skips, three-wave exhaustion, subset persistence, remaining-blocker rejection, full authorization, and P2 recommendations.
cases.observation: Blocker skips were unavailable before exhaustion; afterward only named results were waived and P2 remained non-blocking.

cases.procedure: Exercised custom route skips, partial Seal authorization, same-snapshot retry, repair advance, and summary persistence.
cases.observation: ROUTE skips persisted across snapshots while SEAL skips persisted only on their snapshot and cleared after repair.

cases.procedure: Ran public CLI workflows, compared public JSON with state.json, and verified all named Git identities.
cases.observation: CLI and state agreed on route, actions, results, snapshots, Carry, authorizations, and two prior completed waves with no extra store.

cases.procedure: Inspected the complete base-to-current tree, history, and state, catalog, action, gate, Carry, and snapshot changes.
cases.observation: Phase 5 extended existing owners; QA Review was the only new runtime prompt and no parallel mechanism or compatibility path was introduced.
